text:
Elaine (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — we need owners for AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding. Target publish window: 3 weeks. Main gaps: AMI/container artifacts, billing metering, legal EULA, regional availability, and joint announcement plan. Who can own each?
Sanjay (Cloud): I can own AMI/container packaging + GCP image. Need AMI IDs, test accounts, and an infra smoke test matrix.
Anna (Product): I'll scope packaging (trial plan, premium tiers, support matrix). Need to confirm SKU/plan names. Can we standardize plans across clouds?
Maya (Legal): EULA checklist: export control review, SOC2/ISO attachments, and any data residency addenda. I need the draft EULA ASAP (preferably by EOD Wed).
Rob (Marketplace): Heads up — Azure wants OfferID + PlanIDs early; AWS needs AMI IDs and product codes for the seller portal. GCP requires Marketplace image or container and license info. Also: Azure and AWS have slightly different trial semantics.
Jae (CloudOps): For AWS I need a reproducible AMI build pipeline + an example `aws ec2 describe-images --owners self` snippet for verification. Also we should publish a small health check Lambda for post-deploy smoke tests.
Elaine (Partnerships): Owners map suggestion: AMI/container = Sanjay/Jae, SKU/pricing = Anna, Legal docs = Maya, Portal submission = Rob, Announcement comms = me. 👍 Thoughts?
Sanjay (Cloud): Sounds good. For GCP, I'll produce a container image and a VM image option. Question: do we want a BYOL (bring-your-own-license) plan on Azure? That changes legal wording.
Anna (Product): BYOL only for Enterprise tier. Default should be SaaS/VM metered. We'll keep naming: "Starter", "Business", "Enterprise". Starter = 14d trial, limited tokens/requests.
Maya (Legal): BYOL note — need a short addendum and a supported list of licenses. Also confirm whether any third-party bundled libs have their own export restrictions.
Rob (Marketplace): Submission checklist I'm filling out: publisher profile, logo (1024x1024 png), marketing blurb, screenshots, support URL, privacy policy link, AMI/container artifact, pricing JSON, entitlements mapping. I'll share the exact schema.
Elaine (Partnerships): Links: AWS publisher portal: https://partnercentral.aws.amazon.com/ (placeholder), Azure partner: https://partner.microsoft.com/, GCP console: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace. Use these to pre-fill forms.
Jae (CloudOps): I'll add a CI job: `build-ami.sh --version=0.1.0 --region=us-west-2` and produce AMI IDs. Will push test AMIs to us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
Sanjay (Cloud): For GCP I'll push container image to gcr.io/redwood-inference/marketplace:0.1.0 and provide a testing terraform module.
Anna (Product): Pricing JSON example request: Rob, can you share the format? We need to map plan IDs to internal SKU codes and to billing metrics (vCPU-hours, token-units, seats).
Rob (Marketplace): Will DM the pricing schema but quick example: `{"plan_id":"starter","billing_metric":"monthly_seat","price_cents":0}`. Also note AWS has metering for SaaS (metering API) vs EC2 (AMI hourly).
Maya (Legal): Timeline check — if we want a joint announcement, legal needs 10 business days for co-marketing review + trademark checks for logos.
Elaine (Partnerships): Good call. That pushes publish ~+2 weeks if announcement is simultaneous. Suggest decoupling listing from announcement: list first, announce once partnership comms sign-off.
Anna (Product): Risk note — some customers expect BYOL for gov regions. Let's capture region-by-region availability matrix.
Jae (CloudOps): I'll run the smoke tests and post results to `#eng-sre` and attach the output. Example healthcheck payload: { "status":"ok","version":"0.1.0" }.
Sanjay (Cloud): Need access from Rob to the publisher accounts (AWS Publisher ID, Azure Partner Center ID, GCP Marketplace project). Rob can you share perms?
Rob (Marketplace): I'll provision role-based access. For AWS I'll add `sanjay@redwood` and `jae@redwood` to the publisher account role. Expect invites in ~2 hours.
Elaine (Partnerships): Action items and owners — please confirm by EOD: Sanjay (AMI/container binaries), Jae (CI + smoke tests), Anna (pricing + plan names), Maya (EULA draft), Rob (portal submission + invites), Elaine (announcement draft + PR coordination).
Maya (Legal): Confirmed — I'll upload a EULA redline to the shared drive and ping here when done.
Sanjay (Cloud): Confirmed — will post AMI IDs and container image tags by tomorrow noon PST.
Anna (Product): Confirmed — I'll produce plan mapping + support SLA doc by EOD tomorrow.
Rob (Marketplace): Confirmed — I'm queueing Azure OfferID request and will start the AWS portal flow now.
aws-integration-bot: AWS publisher invite sent to sanjay@redwood. Token expires in 72h.
Elaine (Partnerships): Great progress. Let's reconvene Thu 10am PT for a short sync and to unblock legal/portal issues. I'll send calendar invite. :calendar:
